description:
The protagonists are Teddy, a teddy bear with a nostalgic vision of the past; Luna, a doll who, although new to the store, has an insatiable curiosity; and Wheelie, a red toy car who dreams of speed.

During their journey, the toys face various obstacles in the human world, such as the chaos of the city streets, the dangers of crosswalks and the uncertainties of the road.

Throughout the story, the friendship between the toys grows stronger, and they discover that what keeps them together is the love for what they do and the desire to give other toys the same opportunity to be loved and appreciated.
name: Toy Tale: The Forgotten Factory
intro: This visual novel follows a group of toys who, after being forgotten by children, begin a journey in search of a legendary place: The Forgotten Factory.
